scene: The tunnel opens onto a bustling multi-transit terminal dock.
picture: A flat side view along a wide transit deck. Far left is the archway exit. Left waits a moored brass airship. Centre sits the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair and teal hoodie. Right stands an idling orange delivery truck. Far right rests a candy-striped steam train puffing vapour on tracks.
shown: a tethered brass airship waiting with open hatch on the left
a square orange delivery truck parked idling on the right
a striped steam train puffing sweet vapour on the far right

variants.scene: You roll onto a busy platform alive with engines, neon, and evening echoes.
